# BINRAT GitHub agent instructions

Read [root AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), [founder north star](../docs/BINRAT_FOUNDER_NORTH_STAR.md), [agent work policy](../docs/AGENT_WORK_POLICY.md) before planning.

**Product:** Users employ specialized Rats to investigate crypto; Rats collaborate with typed receipt-bound handoffs, run within explicit budgets, and return findings. **FIND → EMPLOY → LEAVE → RETURN.** The Pons scanner is Rat Zero's source, not the complete product. Token launch remains a separately authorized exact/legal/mechanical track; no false live workforce/stake claim.

**Repository warning:** default \`main\` is an older ArcPad backend snapshot; do not treat its source/layout as current production/brand authority. Reconcile current PRs and deployment facts.

**Agent work:** PLAN → CHANGESET → VERIFY → VERDICT. Before work say USER JOB / PASS / KILL / exact source / scoped budget. Default $0 new spend, 0 paid calls and 0 production writes/messages/merges/signing. One targeted test and one hostile review, one targeted rereview only for Critical/High repairs. Repeat same-seam blockers only with genuinely new evidence. Stop at the gate; no autonomous next sprint.
